Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit. K. P. S. Menon took over in 1952, and Radhakrishnan's tenure is remembered for his April 1952 meeting with Stalin. I answered from memory this time and did not re-check the sources cited earlier.

CONFIDENCE: 92
